links.note: Antonym drill on 'समृद्ध'. The word occurs in the lesson only in the mother's in-flight account of Assam -- 'नृत्य की भी एक समृद्ध परंपरा है' -- which is 32526. 32537 re-quotes that whole line as a discussion prompt, but its own items ask what the line means, not the word's opposite.

Antonym drill on 'सुंदर'. The essay uses सुंदर once, in its opening claim about India -- 'रंग-बिरंगी, सुंदर, प्राचीन और जीवन से भरी संस्कृति' -- which is 32524. No other concept in this chapter carries the word.

Antonym drill on 'आकर्षण'. आकर्षण appears in exactly one sentence of the lesson -- 'शक्ति, बल और आकर्षण प्रदर्शित किया', the closing judgement on the women Sattriya dancers -- which is 32533. 32532 covers the ऋषियों का श्राप half of that same performance and never uses the word.

Antonym drill on 'बल'. बल occurs only in that same sentence, 'शक्ति, बल और आकर्षण', the women dancers' power that 32533 is built on. 32534, the next scene (श्यामा और रीता का साक्षात्कार), does not use it.

'माँ एलेसेंड्रा के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सत्य है' with the textbook's four options verbatim -- this IS the first मेरी समझ से MCQ that 32536 describes, including the deliberate असमिया-शब्द distractor. 32525 supplies the true statement but is the narrative, not the question.

'अनु और एंजेला ने तुरंत एक-दूसरे की तरफ़ देखा' क्यों, with the four options खिलौने / समान आयु / अंग्रेज़ी / असमिया -- the second मेरी समझ से MCQ that 32536 lists. 32529 narrates the detail that both were ten, but this is the exercise item with its option set.

Names the mother -- एलेसेंड्रा. She is named once, in the sentence that starts the whole plot, 'उसकी माँ एलेसेंड्रा एक डॉक्यूमेंट्री फ़िल्म निर्माता थीं', which is 32525. 32526 has her arranging the trip but never names her.
What kind of film-maker एलेसेंड्रा was -- डॉक्यूमेंट्री. Her profession is stated only in 32525. 32535 is the लेखिका जया मेहता introduction, a different woman.
Which Assam tradition the grant was for -- नृत्य परंपरा. The ब्रिटिश अकादमी funding and its subject sit in 32525. 32526 lists Assam's वन्य जीवन, रेशम and चाय (the distractors) but not the grant.

Bihu is celebrated for the arrival of which season -- वसंत. 32528 is the only concept that ties बिहू to 'फसल लगाने से लेकर बसंत के आगमन तक'. 32527 counts the three Bihus against the farming calendar and never names spring.
How many times a year बिहू is celebrated -- तीन बार, 32527's own headline fact. 32540 is the exercise table that asks what farmers are doing at each of the three, not how many there are.

What बिहू is mainly tied to -- कृषि और फसल. 32527 carries the mother's explanation at मलंग that 'बिहू एक कृषि आधारित त्योहार है'. 32538 only sets the essay question 'कैसे' on that statement; this MCQ wants the fact.

When रोंगाली बिहू falls -- अप्रैल. Placing a named बिहू on the calendar is 32540's table work: which बिहू एंजेला came for, and what farmers were doing then. 32527 says बिहू comes three times but dates none of them.
Which Assam festival एंजेला got to see -- बिहू, the मलंग village evening that 32527 narrates. 32531 and 32532 are the सत्रिया performances she saw later, which are dances, not a festival.

What सत्रिया नृत्य is tied to -- धार्मिक परंपराओं. 32531 is the monastery scene: young साधु dancing in the वैष्णव मठ hall, and the dance later coming out of the मठ. The distractor ग्रामीण जीवन is बिहू's answer (32528), so the item turns on Sattriya's monastic home.

Whose द्वारपाल जय and विजय were -- भगवान विष्णु के. 32532 introduces them as Vishnu's two gatekeepers and the sages' curse. 32533 covers only the resolution, Vishnu's promise, by which point their identity is already given.
Two-column matching of सत्र, बोहाग बिहू, लंदन, गुवाहाटी and ब्रिटिश अकादमी to their descriptions -- this is the 'मिलकर करें मिलान' block that opens 32537. No narrative concept holds all five terms.

Fill-in whose answer is वैष्णव मठ -- the place एलेसेंड्रा filmed for the documentary. 32531 is the वैष्णव मठ सभागार scene. 32534 covers the साक्षात्कार of श्यामा and रीता, but the answer key names the मठ, not the interview.
The girls' dress colours at the बिहू dance -- लाल and बादामी. That detail belongs to 32527's मलंग description, boys with वाद्ययंत्र and girls in red and almond. No other concept describes costume.

The writer at whose house एंजेला stayed -- रीना सेन. 32529 is the दक्षिणापथ सत्र arrival where रीना सेन is met and the week's stay is settled. 32535's writer is जया मेहता, the lesson's author, not a character.

What अनु's favourite toy was made of -- लकड़ी, the wooden तीर-कमान. 32530 is the toys scene. 32541's खिलौने exercise asks students to compare अनु's toys with London's and bring a handmade one; this is the narrative fact.
True/false on एंजेला's school being far from home -- असत्य, because 32525 states 'उसका स्कूल घर से दूर नहीं था'. 32526 is the holiday-extension arrangement with the school, not its distance.

True/false that बिहू is agriculture-based -- bare recall of 32527's own sentence. 32538 holds the essay version of this ('कैसे?'), which demands the sowing / transplanting / harvest explanation; a सत्य-असत्य does not.
True/false that अनु taught एंजेला असमिया words -- सत्य, stated in 32530 alongside the toys. 32536 uses the same fact only as a false option about the mother, so it cannot be where this is tested.

True/false that the two girls watched the जय-विजय story performed by women. 32532 is that night: अनु's permission, the curtain rising on दो महिलाएँ in white turban-like caps. 32533 judges the performance's quality, which this item does not ask about.

True/false that the grant was for Assam's चाय परंपरा -- असत्य; 32525 records it as the नृत्य परंपरा grant. 32526 is where tea gardens are mentioned, which is what makes the item a trap, but the grant's subject is 32525's.

Passage ending at 'सच साबित होने वाली हैं', with three sub-questions on where she lived, what stories she liked and what she had no idea about -- all three answers are inside 32525. The passage stops before the trip is arranged, so 32526 is not touched.

Flight passage; the closing sub-question asks what एलेसेंड्रा's documentary was centred on -- 'असम की नृत्य परंपरा और महत्व', which is 32526's own line about the documentary's centre. 32527 begins at the गुवाहाटी hotel and owns only the three-बिहू sub-question.

Passage on उत्तरी असम, दक्षिणापथ सत्र, रीना सेन and अनु; the sub-questions ask why the mother went north, whom she met and why, and what the two girls thought -- 32529 end to end. 32530 starts at the toys, after this passage closes.

The stem quotes 32533's own closing sentences verbatim -- 'शक्ति, बल और आकर्षण' and the women's प्रस्तुति being better than the men's -- and sub-question 3, 'एंजेला को क्या अद्भुत लगा', is answerable only there. 32534 supplies the dancers' names in two later sub-questions but is a different scene, the साक्षात्कार.

A longer version of the opening passage, extended through the ब्रिटिश अकादमी grant to the holiday extension and पिता ब्रायन; its final sub-question asks why the mother had the holidays extended, which only 32526 answers. 32525 ends before the school is approached.

मलंग passage -- the मंच under the बरगद, the crowd, the टाइम मशीन feeling, boys with वाद्ययंत्र, girls in लाल and बादामी -- and all five sub-questions stay inside it. 32541 is the टाइम मशीन exercise block that only borrows the phrase; 32539 asks why the stage was under the banyan, not where it was.

Four of the five sub-questions are the curse: which dance they went to, which story, who cursed जय-विजय (ऋषियों ने) and why -- 32532's material. The passage runs on into विष्णु's promise, which is 32533, but that is one sub-question out of five.

Names लेखिका जया मेहता and asks for the reader's own response to her पाठ and whether it drew them towards dance -- 32535 is the author introduction and the closing scene where एंजेला performs for her class. 32524 frames India's culture but says nothing about the writer.

Quotes the first of the two 'पंक्तियों पर चर्चा' lines -- Assam's पूर्वोत्तर position, वन्य-जीवन, रेशम, चाय के बागान -- and asks for the student's own thoughts, which is the block 32537 describes. 32526 is where the line is spoken; the task here is the reflection exercise.

The same 'पंक्तियों पर चर्चा' line with its second half restored ('नृत्य की भी एक समृद्ध परंपरा है'), same reflection task. It is a second rendering of the same exercise item, not a different scene, so it stays on the exercise block rather than on 32526.

Quotes the second 'पंक्तियों पर चर्चा' line -- 'पूरी दुनिया की संस्कृतियों में लोग नृत्य और संगीत से अपनी भावनाओं को व्यक्त करते हैं' -- for reflection. 32528 is where the mother says it; 32537 is the block that sets both lines as the task, and this item is that task.

'एंजेला के मन में कौन-कौन से विचार चल रहे होंगे' -- the first of 32538's four सोच-विचार items, an inference the text never states. 32528 reports only that many thoughts were running in her mind; it does not list them.

'बिहू एक कृषि आधारित त्योहार है।' कैसे? -- 32538's second सोच-विचार item, which wants the sowing, transplanting and harvest occasions assembled into an argument. 32527 states the bare fact, which is what the सत्य-असत्य item tests instead.

Hands over the statement that असम stayed in एंजेला's mind after she left India and asks for examples from the text -- 32538's third item, the one that gives a claim and makes you hunt its evidence. The evidence itself lies in 32534 and 32535; the task is 32538's.

'समय के बदलने के साथ सत्रिया नृत्य की परंपरा में क्या बदलाव आया' -- 32538's fourth सोच-विचार item. 32531 narrates the change, monks leaving the मठ and being expelled and women on stage today; this is the exercise that asks for it.

'एंजेला और उसका परिवार बिहू नृत्य और उसके उत्सव को देखकर अचंभित क्यों हो गया' -- the first अनुमान या कल्पना से question that 32539 lists. 32527 describes what they saw; the reason for the amazement is inference, which is 32539's.

What तैयारियाँ the family would have made before the journey -- 32539's second कल्पना question. The text never says, which is why it sits under अनुमान; 32526 covers only the holiday permission that actually happened.
Why the मंच would have been built under the बरगद -- 32539's third कल्पना question. 32527 records that it was built there; the reason is guesswork the exercise asks the student to supply.
If you had a टाइम मशीन, where and when would you go -- the first question of 32541's time-machine block. 32527 contains only एंजेला's feeling of sitting in one; this is the student-facing exercise.

What not-yet-invented thing would you build -- the companion question in 32541's block, which introduces the टाइम मशीन as something not yet made. No narrative concept asks the student to invent anything.
The संग्रहालय prompt, quoting 32541's own line that a museum visit can feel like a टाइम मशीन journey. It belongs to the same block, not to 32542's letter-and-डाक-टिकट section.
Which book जया मेहता wrote -- नृत्य कथा, given only in 32535's author note. No narrative concept names the source book.
Asks for a short introduction to लेखिका जया मेहता -- नृत्यांगना, लेखिका, शिक्षिका, ओडिसी में पारंगत. That is 32535's लेखिका परिचय. 32529's writer is रीना सेन, a character in the essay.
Where एलेसेंड्रा filmed the young साधु dancing -- वैष्णव मठ के सभागार, 32531's scene. 32529 only brings the family near a सत्र; the filming inside the monastery hall is 32531's.
Why एलेसेंड्रा came to India -- the ब्रिटिश अकादमी grant for a documentary on Assam's नृत्य परंपरा, which is 32525. 32526 carries the journey itself, not its reason.
